calibration_external.limit: Separate aggregate surveys; not matched individual outcomes. Reported job-loss comparison is a lower-bound CPS definition, not clean calibrated overprediction; 12m SCE probability converted to 3m in cited study. No new independent estimates.

comparison_rule: Do not subtract population belief shares from firm action shares, or diffusion index from actual employment growth. Different timing, estimands and populations. Adoption correlated with expectations, not causal estimate. Job postings differ from employment and hiring.

hypotheses.claim: Adoption primarily changes task productivity and skill demand before broad employment displacement.
hypotheses.counter: Reduced hiring among adopters may foreshadow substitution; self-report not aggregate output.

hypotheses.claim: Lower hiring and future displacement emerge as AI is integrated.
hypotheses.counter: Some AI users expand hiring; vacancy trends predate release, no clean aggregate causal break.

hypotheses.claim: Growing firms adopt AI and expect expansion; correlation can arise without causal AI effect.
hypotheses.counter: Reported adjusted revenue expectation differences persist after measured controls, but unobserved selection remains.
tests: pre-adoption growth and independent adoption variation

candidate_recheck.method: Same-author cross-check Q3/Q4 original PDF text, Q4 HTML; no visual confirmation, no raw bytes. All existing numeric values match published rounded medians. Original payroll realization formula not certified.
candidate_recheck.beige_date: Explicit Last Update Nov 25 2026 confirmed; exact public clock not certified.
